description: SSOT for CI-hard checks that run in seconds without network/services. CI workflows call scripts/governance/run-ci-checks.sh --all --only <id>; .githooks/pre-push runs --changed. Edit here, never inline the command in a workflow. Slow checks carry paths so --changed skips them; --all (CI) always runs them.
